entries.name: step-18
entries.note: Worker-mode V1 SQLite conformance suites run in their own serial step (#1504 W2e). Each spawns real node:worker_threads workers, and Phase 2.4 respawns one per simulated crash, so running them inside the --test-concurrency=12 step loaded the box enough to push the /health p50 and p99 latency budgets past their thresholds. Those budgets guard something real and were not relaxed; the load was isolated instead.
